tapToClose: Tap ✕ to close the menu and get back to your ship.
threeCompaniesHaveFought: Three companies have fought over these stars for a million years, and they all need pilots. Here are 30,000 CR to start.
aliensHoldEverySector: Aliens hold every sector and drop all the ore, credits and Aether. Hunt them to grow strong. Rival pilots hunt them too.
creditsCrBuyGear: Credits (CR) buy gear, XP unlocks levels, Aether (AE) is the rare currency. Your station has a safe zone: nobody can attack you there, and it is the only place to change equipment.
orangeDotsAreAliens: Orange dots are aliens. Click the minimap to fly there.
orangeDotsAreAliens2: Orange dots are aliens. Tap the minimap to fly there.
followTheArrowTo: Follow the arrow to the nearest bonus box. Click in space to fly there, then click the crate.
followTheArrowTo2: Follow the arrow to the nearest bonus box. Fly there with the stick, then tap the crate.
noCrateInSight: No crate in sight? Bonus boxes are scattered around every sector: fly around with clicks on the minimap. You can also press Skip step.
slots10HoldAmmo: Slots 1-0 hold ammo and rockets. Click Arc Cells (key 2): double damage.
theseButtonsHoldAmmo: These buttons hold ammo and rockets. Tap Arc Cells: double damage.
slotMovedRightClickAny: Slot moved? Right-click any slot (or use its small arrow) to put Arc Cells back.
followTheArrowTo3: Follow the arrow to a Tardi: slow, and it never attacks first. Click it to target it.
followTheArrowTo4: Follow the arrow to a Tardi: slow, and it never attacks first. Fly there, then tap it.
noArrowNoTardi: No arrow? No Tardi is nearby: aliens stay out of the safe zone, so click the minimap away from the station (orange dots are aliens).
clickTheTargetAgain: Click the target again, or press Space, to shoot. Press again to stop.
tapTheRedAttack: Tap the red ATTACK button: with no target it picks the nearest alien. Drag it to aim the cone at one yourself, then let go to fire.
lostTheTargetClick: Lost the target? Click any alien to select it again.
keepShootingPress5: Keep shooting. Press 5 for a Dart Rocket. Click the drops to collect them.
keepShootingTapThe: Keep shooting. Tap the Dart Rocket. Fly over the drops to collect them.
noAlienNearbyClick: No alien nearby? Click the minimap to fly further from the station.
hitsDrainTheShield: Hits drain the shield, then the hull. At zero hull you respawn at the station and your items wear down. Repair with Aether or in Equipment. Low hull? Fly back to the safe zone.
missionsShopEquipmentAnd: Missions, Shop, Equipment and Galaxy are around the HUD. Each one explains itself the first time you open it.
missionsShopEquipmentAnd2: Missions, Shop, Equipment and Galaxy are in the Command menu: tap ☰. Each one explains itself the first time you open it.
gatesLeadToFarther: Gates lead to farther sectors with stronger aliens and better rewards. Fly onto a gate and press J. The Galaxy screen (M) shows the way.
gatesLeadToFarther2: Gates lead to farther sectors with stronger aliens and better rewards. Fly onto a gate and tap JUMP. The Galaxy screen shows the way.
